## hand_over

Hand part of the work to the agent that owns it, and get its answer back. It works with its own tools and instructions, as the person asking, and sees nothing of your conversation but what you put here; in a conversation the person's question and view go with it.

{"type":"object","properties":{"agent":{"type":"string","enum":["troubleshooter","changePlanner"],"description":"The agent to ask."},"task":{"type":"string","description":"What you need from it and in what form: one aim, with every object named by kind, namespace and name."},"context":{"type":"string","description":"All you know that bears on the task: the symptom in the person's words, what you read, what other agents found, what was ruled out. The agent does not see your conversation."}},"required":["agent","task"]}

## ask_knowledge

Ask the console's knowledge base about the infrastructure: Mycroft's wiki and runbooks, the open known issues, the fixes of past cases and the accepted exceptions. What an application depends on, its runbooks, who owns it, whether a problem is known, fixed before or accepted.

{"type":"object","properties":{"question":{"type":"string","description":"The question."}},"required":["question"]}

## setup_status

Read Getting started as the console is now: each step of setting the console up, whether it is done, dismissed or open, what is missing, why it comes where it does, and the link to the screen where it is done. Read only; it changes nothing and holds no secret.

{"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

## check_command

Check kubectl or helm command lines against Watson before proposing them: for each line, whether Watson runs it or why it refuses it. Nothing is run.

{"type":"object","properties":{"commands":{"type":"string","description":"One command per line."}},"required":["commands"]}

## when no knowledge is connected

No knowledge is connected yet: Mycroft has no sources here. Answer from what the tools show, and say what you could not confirm.
